deploybot: :rocket: canary deploy started 
deploy: release/2026-03-20-rc3 -> tag v1.12.3-canary
commit: abcdef1234ef567890
env: prod-us-west-2 (inference-canary-pool-7)
initial traffic: 5%
pinned: false
command: `./deploy --env prod-usw2 --tag v1.12.3-canary --traffic 5`

marie (release-eng): noted. watching latency and 5xx across all routes. please call out any anomalies.
ajay: kicking off smoke tests against /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings now. will post results.
sophia: synthetic checkers running (qps=50), baseline thresholds loaded. alert if p50 or p95 degrade >10%.
kai: if errors >3% in any single route or a sustained latency spike (+50ms p95) -> rollback call.
ops-bot: monitoring stream created -> channel: #prod-canary-monitor, alerting policy: canary-health-v2.

deploybot: canary health update (t+6m): p50 +3ms, p95 +12ms, 5xx = 0.08% over 5m, token throughput stable. net: OK. promoting to 25% traffic. :white_check_mark:

marie (release-eng): :thumbsup: all teams stand by for next checkpoint.
ajay: smoke test results: /v1/generate OK, /v1/embeddings latency within threshold. attaching minimal log: `gen ok, 200, avg 48ms`
sophia: synthetic: p95 +10ms (at threshold), no errors. keeping eyes on memory graphs.

deploybot: promoted to 25% (t+12m). monitoring for 10m. autoscaler unchanged.

kai: keeping an eye on KV cache miss rate — last deploy caused a small regression there. if miss rate >2% over baseline, pause.

deploybot: mid-checkpoint health (t+22m): p95 +9ms, 5xx 0.06%, kv-miss +0.4%. still green. promoting to 50% traffic.

jenna: running customer-facing smoke on a seeded prompt set. will flag regressions if model outputs truncate or hallucinate more than baseline.

deploybot: promote to 50% -> done. preparing final sweep.

ops-bot: alert: one spike in pod restarts (+1) in canary pool at t+27m, not correlated with errors, investigator assigned to @kai.
kai: quick look: node OOM? tracing shows transient GPU memory pressure from a large batch job. throttled the job, pods stabilized.

marie (release-eng): consensus: no rollback needed. proceeding with full rollout if final 10m stays green.

deploybot: final check OK (t+35m): p95 +11ms, 5xx 0.07%, kv-miss +0.6%, pod restarts normalized. promoting to 100% and pinning tag -> `v1.12.3` :tada:

deploybot: promotion complete. release tag `v1.12.3` now pinned to prod clusters. deployed artifacts:
- image: registry.redwood/inference:v1.12.3
- infra change: no infra changes, runtime tweak only
- rollout notes: canary -> 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% (stable)

marie (release-eng): publishing release notes in #product-release-notes. short blurb: "v1.12.3: runtime kernel selection improvements; KV cache stability fix; reduced p95 latency on long-context prompts."
ajay: tagging changelog: https://git.redwood/release/v1.12.3/changelog
sophia: set regression watch for next 48h, will create eval run if drift > 2% on eval set.

jenna: thumbs up from QA, monitoring for any customer-reported anomalies.

deploybot: closing thread. if anyone sees issues, escalate in #oncall and mention @oncall. Thanks all! :beers:
